[Use : H+ (aq) + OH (aq) H2O : H = 57.1 kJ mol1]

Specific heat of H2O = 4.18 J K1 g1

density of H2O = 1.0 g cm3

Assume no change in volume of solution on mixing.

(L.R.)

en.explanation:
2SO2(g) + O2(g) 2SO3(g)


Final total pressure = 625 + 250 = 875 m bar
